hooks.name: Comment Check
hooks.description: On saving any .js file, checks for JSDoc comments, missing inline comments on complex logic, and leftover console.log statements.

action.prompt:
When this JavaScript file is saved, review it and check:

1. Does every function have a JSDoc comment explaining what it does?
2. Are there any complex logic blocks that lack inline comments?
3. Are there any `console.log` statements that look like debugging leftovers?

If any of these issues are found, provide a brief, friendly summary of what needs attention. Keep the message short — just flag the issues, don't automatically fix them unless asked.

Format your response as:
- ✅ Comments: [status]
- ⚠️ Debug logs: [status]
- 💡 Suggestions: [any quick wins]
